baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence yuhibbuna al-ajilah / yadharuna wara'ahum / yawman thaqilan.
baseline_models.mechanism: Clinging preference fixes action on what has been brought forward, while active leaving puts a severe, weight-bearing occasion on the far side of the operative horizon.

activation_trace.role: Love as clinging attachment supplies the force that holds attention to the present object.
Hastening and bringing forward makes al-ajilah a time-domain brought close for immediate uptake.
Leaving or letting be makes the displacement of the other day an active posture.
The far side, whether behind or ahead, supplies an excluded horizon rather than a fixed compass direction.
An event-day or severe occasion makes the day a happening to be faced, not just a calendar unit.
Heaviness against lightness gives the excluded occasion real load and resistance.

changed_reading.before: They prefer the present and neglect a difficult future day.
changed_reading.after: Their attachment to brought-forward time actively pushes a severe, weight-bearing event beyond the horizon from which they act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The evaluative contrast between al-ajilah and yawman thaqilan.
baseline_models.mechanism: Desire approves hurried provision while relinquishing what is weighty in the sense of preciousness and high worth, so the verse can diagnose inverted valuation as well as short time preference.

activation_trace.role: Formulaic approval and utmost desire supplies emphatic positive valuation of the chosen object.
Hurried provision renders the immediate as consumable value delivered before delay.
Leaving supplies the act by which the more consequential object is relinquished.
Weight as preciousness and high worth permits thaqilan to mark value and consequence, not pain alone.

changed_reading.before: The future day is heavy because it is onerous.
changed_reading.after: They prize hurried provision and abandon the day that carries the greater weight of value and consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collision of yuhibbuna, al-ajilah, and thaqilan.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of attachment depicts an exhausted animal fixed in place, while haste moves toward the near and heaviness can produce sluggishness; together they form a paradox in which urgency immobilizes moral movement.

activation_trace.role: The animal fixed in place from exhaustion supplies attachment as immobilization rather than affection alone.
Hastening supplies the apparent forward motion whose effect is being tested.
Heaviness as sluggishness supplies the resulting incapacity to move toward the excluded day.

changed_reading.before: They move too quickly toward short-term goods.
changed_reading.after: Their haste is also an inertia: attachment to immediacy pins them in place and leaves them sluggish before what matters later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The feeding scene refuses immediate repayment and thanks, while the later declaration returns acknowledged value to completed effort. Al-ajilah therefore becomes an immediate-reciprocity economy, not merely the present moment.

activation_trace.role: Clinging preference anchors the changed reading in what these subjects choose to value.
Hurried provision supplies the focus image of value consumed or settled immediately.
Recognition of benefit and praise names the immediate social return explicitly refused by the feeders.
Feeding another supplies a transfer of present consumable value without demanded settlement.
Will and intention locate the contrast in what return the agents seek.
Recompensing an act with its due supplies the exchange that is declined in the near term.
Work, earning, and action supply the effort whose recognized return arrives on a longer horizon.

structural_cues: 76:8-9 join feeding with an explicit refusal of repayment and thanks.
76:22 closes the reward sequence by calling the recipients' effort thanked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present giving, refused human settlement, and later acknowledged effort; I infer two rival exchange horizons. The love-object in 76:8 may have another referent, but the refusal of near return still supports the contrast.

changed_reading.before: They simply prefer present life to the future.
changed_reading.after: They are attached to value that pays, praises, or satisfies now, unlike action released from immediate reciprocity and answered on a deferred horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier descriptions turn the day into a severe occasion whose harm spreads, gathers, and must be warded off. Its heaviness is dynamic exposure to an approaching event, not static gloom.

activation_trace.role: The focus day as a severe occasion anchors the event model.
Literal heaviness supplies the load borne when that event arrives.
The repeated event-day identifies the feared occasion with the focus day.
Spreading after light movement gives the day's evil an expanding reach opposed to the focus weight.
A severe hateful day intensifies the event quality rather than merely assigning an emotion to a date.
A severe day of widespread evil combines intensity with diffusion.
Warding off harm makes exposure to the event a causal risk from which protection is possible.

structural_cues: The same day is feared in 76:7 and 76:10, then its evil is warded off in 76:11.
The sequence moves from anticipated spread to experienced protection before returning to abandonment in 76:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a spreading evil, severe day, and warding; I infer that thaqilan names the load of exposure when the event catches up. A live alternative is that heaviness marks only moral gravity, not experienced pressure.

changed_reading.before: A hard future date is ignored.
changed_reading.after: An advancing, spreading occasion carries a load from which some are protected, while these subjects place it outside their field of response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Contextual covering and concealment alternate with repeated seeing and final disclosure. Wara'ahum, activated by its covering branch, becomes a managed visibility boundary: the day is not absent but kept out of sight.

activation_trace.role: Active leaving makes the loss of visibility an enacted choice.
Covering and putting out of sight directly anchors the occlusion mechanism in wara'ahum.
Covering supplies the context's recurring operation of making a reality unavailable to view.
Concealment supplies a second context image in which hiddenness coexists with real presence.
Repeated ocular and inward seeing supplies the opposed operation of bringing the beyond into view.
Disclosure to a knower prevents out-of-sight from becoming nonexistence.

structural_cues: 76:13, 76:19, and 76:20 repeatedly stage what is or is not seen.
The focus construction combines an active leaving verb with a spatial term whose packet branch includes covering from sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover, concealment, seeing, and disclosure; I infer a deliberately maintained horizon of attention. The simpler live alternative is ordinary temporal neglect expressed by a spatial idiom.

changed_reading.before: They forget or disregard the future day.
changed_reading.after: They maintain the day as an occluded reality, actively placing what can be seen and known beyond their operative field of vision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Restraint and repeated morning-evening-night practice stretch attention across a long duration. The focus fault is therefore a malformed temporal discipline, with immediate attachment countered by practices that keep action oriented beyond the instant.

activation_trace.role: Clinging attachment anchors the attentional habit that must be countered.
Hastening supplies the compressed temporal mode opposed by sustained practice.
Holding the self back from panic supplies deliberate resistance to immediate pressure.
The first part of the day supplies one recurring temporal boundary for remembrance.
Evening supplies the matching boundary that extends orientation across the day.
Night and its darkness extend the practice beyond daylight visibility.
Long duration turns the schedule into sustained temporal endurance rather than a momentary gesture.

structural_cues: The commands of 76:24-26 immediately precede the diagnosis in 76:27.
Morning, evening, and a long night distribute remembrance and submission across the full temporal cycle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint and a recurring day-night cadence; I infer that this cadence retrains the horizon distorted by love of immediacy. Alternatively, the commands may prepare obedience without functioning as a direct remedy for that distortion.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a preference for short-term goods.
changed_reading.after: It diagnoses a temporal-attention habit opposed by patient, repeated practice that prevents the weighty horizon from slipping behind the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel moves from desire to created, tightly bound, replaceable bodies. Activated by bodily heaviness, the heavy day becomes a load borne by a constituted creature whose cohesion and continuity are not self-owned.

activation_trace.role: Pregnancy becoming heavy supplies an embodied, developmental form of load in the focus adjective.
Leaving anchors the creature's attempted disengagement from the consequence.
Bringing creation into being supplies the body's dependence on an originating act.
Tight formation and cohesive joints materialize the creature as a bound structure.
Tightening a knot or bond supplies the force maintaining that structure.
One thing standing in another's place makes bodily continuity substitutable rather than autonomous.
A counterpart or likeness supplies what can replace the present embodied subject.

structural_cues: 76:28 follows the focus ayah without a scene break and shifts directly to creation, bodily binding, and replacement.
The focus adjective has a branch of bodily heaviness, allowing the sequel to materialize rather than merely repeat its load.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created cohesion, tightening, and replaceability; I infer that creaturely dependence makes dismissal of the heavy day a false posture of bodily control. Alternatively, 76:28 may assert power without specifying how the day's heaviness is experienced.

changed_reading.before: The day is psychologically or morally burdensome.
changed_reading.after: The day bears on an embodied, bound, replaceable creature, exposing the bodily dependence hidden by attachment to the immediate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured vessels, expansive well-being, great dominion, and acknowledged effort create a field of calibrated worth. Within it, thaqilan can signal consequential value that outweighs hurried provision.

activation_trace.role: Hurried provision anchors the lower, immediately delivered side of the valuation contrast.
Weight as preciousness and high worth anchors the alternative force of thaqilan.
A measure by which something reaches its proper limit supplies calibrated rather than arbitrary value.
Well-being and favor supply the positive substance of the deferred outcome.
Dominion and authority supply scale to what lies beyond immediate provision.
The magnitude of an affair amplifies weight as consequence and importance.
Work and earning connect the deferred field of value to prior action.

structural_cues: 76:12-22 expands from patient action into a carefully measured reward scene and then names it recompense.
The focus contrast follows that extended display of value, making mere unpleasantness too narrow for thaqilan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, well-being, dominion, magnitude, and effort; I infer that these recalibrate weight as worth. The live alternative is that the reward panorama contrasts with a day whose heaviness remains purely punitive.

changed_reading.before: The heavy day is only a threatening burden.
changed_reading.after: The abandoned day is also weighty because it carries the decisive valuation and return of action, outweighing provision obtained in haste.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from temporal language into seed, premature bearing, green produce, and harvest timing. It remains anchored in the focus roots for love, immediacy, and heaviness and in packet-backed maturation cues; render it only as a material analogy, not as a lexical gloss of al-ajilah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-ajilah as premature yield and yawman thaqilan as the weight reached through maturation.

activation_trace.role: Seed-grain as a carried kernel supplies the beginning of a maturation cycle within the focus verb's root.
Premature bearing makes immediacy a yield taken before its proper term.
The arrival of harvest time supplies the mature temporal endpoint opposed to premature taking.
Taking produce while still green supplies the concrete error of grasping before completion.
Pregnancy becoming heavy supplies ripening fullness as accumulated weight.

changed_reading.after: They prefer premature yield, like taking what is still green, and abandon the maturation whose fullness eventually becomes weighty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the contextual surface is garments while a branch of the same root depicts recompense returning to its doer. It remains valid as a branch activation tied to the focus's far-side and high-worth images; downstream prose should mark it as a cross-branch materialization, not claim that thiyab itself means reward here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Wara'ahum as the far side and thaqilan as high worth whose return is left beyond the subject.

activation_trace.role: The far side supplies the deferred location from which consequence can return.
Weight as preciousness supplies the value carried by the deferred return.
Recompense returning to its worker activates the garments as an exploratory bodily image of returned action.
Work and earning identify the prior action to which the delayed value returns.

changed_reading.before: They put the consequential day behind them.
changed_reading.after: They leave beyond themselves the weighty return of action, while the later clothing scene tentatively materializes recompense as something that comes back upon the body.

strongest_changes: The present/future contrast became a contrast between immediate reciprocity and action whose acknowledged return is deferred.
The heavy day became an advancing, spreading occasion from which protection is causally meaningful.
Leaving the day behind became active management of visibility rather than passive forgetting.
The immediately preceding day-night discipline emerged as a counterpractice to compressed temporal attention.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted a simple temporal warning into mechanisms of exchange, visibility, embodied dependence, disciplined duration, and calibrated worth while preserving the focus verse's six lexical anchors.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether thaqilan should carry precious worth alongside burden, or whether that branch should remain only exploratory.
Whether the bodily-heaviness activation in 76:28 is a real material continuation or an overextension of a distant branch.
Whether wara'ahum marks deliberate occlusion or only the ordinary idiom of disregarding what lies ahead.
